items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: Percy and George Lewis's band played a little bit... those were their interpretation of the real Rollins guys... don't care for George Lewis

ctx.x: Do you think that it would help if every guy took piano in the back?

Yeah, absolutely. Couldn't go wrong. Keep more harmony? Yeah, this process speeds things up. And then, you see, for New Orleans things, and this is the hardest thing, the modern guys could play New Orleans jazz if they wanted to, but the hardest thing to do is to funnel all this background and training into a very simple form of music and discipline yourself. That is where all the guys playing these days that aren't really saying much are having troubles because they don't realize the amount of discipline this…
brass band style? Do you think that has any influence on the band style?
